```{python}
#| echo: false
import json
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd
import plotly.graph_objects as go
from itables import show as itables_show

DATA = Path("data")
sigma = json.loads((DATA / "sigma_survey.json").read_text())

```

::: panel-tabset
## 中文

### 不可行性结论

在 SESOI $\pm 0.010$ 下通过 Jennison–Turnbull 群序贯门宣告等价，需要各眼的重复 CI 落入 $[-0.010, +0.010]$。在文献记录的月频 rank-IC 噪声地板（$\sigma \approx 0.10$）下，**宣告等价**所需最小样本量为：

::: columns
::: {.column width="33%"}
::: {.callout-important title="Look 1（计划 n=60）"}
**72.5 年**

$z_1 = 2.772$ · RCI 99.44%
:::
:::

::: {.column width="33%"}
::: {.callout-warning title="Look 2（计划 n=90）"}
**48.3 年**

$z_2 = 2.263$ · RCI 97.64%
:::
:::

::: {.column width="34%"}
::: {.callout-tip title="Look 3（计划 n=120）"}
**36.2 年**

$z_3 = 1.960$ · RCI 95.00%
:::
:::
:::

2000 次 block bootstrap 给出三眼 $P(\text{等价}) = 0.0000$。

### 观测 $\sigma$ vs 纯噪声界

零预测力假设下 Spearman rank-IC 的闭式标准差为 $\sigma_{\text{null}} = 1/\sqrt{N_{\text{cross}}-1}$，对我们的横截面给出 $\sigma_{\text{null}} \in [0.027, 0.047]$。然而跨 **21 个 IC 系列**的观测 $\sigma(\text{IC})$ 一致地是该界的 **2.0–4.4 倍**（中位 **3.4 倍**）。

::: {.callout-important title="地板来自 ML 噪声超额，非纯数学"}
在纯噪声界 $\sigma = 0.047$ 下，look-3 本可勉强达标（$n_{\min} \approx 83 < 120$ 月）。地板之所以绑定，是因为真实 ML rank-IC 带有相对闭式界 **2.0–4.4×**（中位 3.4×）的稳健噪声超额——源于模型拟合噪声、横截面异方差、与重叠前瞻收益。
:::

### 解读

这把"$\sigma \approx 0.10$ 是地板"细化为机制性陈述：**功率地板 = 闭式抽样界与经验稳健 ML 噪声超额之间的差距。** 该超额可复现——任何研究者都能在自己的月频 rank-IC 系列上算 $\sigma(\text{IC})$ 并与 $1/\sqrt{N-1}$ 比较。

## English

### The infeasibility result

Declaring equivalence at SESOI $\pm 0.010$ via a Jennison–Turnbull group-sequential gate requires the look-specific repeated CI to fit inside $[-0.010, +0.010]$. At the documented monthly rank-IC noise floor ($\sigma \approx 0.10$), the minimum sample sizes needed to *declare equivalence* are:

::: columns
::: {.column width="33%"}
::: {.callout-important title="Look 1 (planned n=60)"}
**72.5 years**

$z_1 = 2.772$ · RCI 99.44%
:::
:::

::: {.column width="33%"}
::: {.callout-warning title="Look 2 (planned n=90)"}
**48.3 years**

$z_2 = 2.263$ · RCI 97.64%
:::
:::

::: {.column width="34%"}
::: {.callout-tip title="Look 3 (planned n=120)"}
**36.2 years**

$z_3 = 1.960$ · RCI 95.00%
:::
:::
:::

A 2,000-replication block bootstrap gives $P(\text{equivalence}) = 0.0000$ at all three planned looks.

### Observed $\sigma$ vs the pure-noise bound

The closed-form std of a Spearman rank-IC under the null of no predictability is $\sigma_{\text{null}} = 1/\sqrt{N_{\text{cross}}-1}$, giving $\sigma_{\text{null}} \in [0.027, 0.047]$ for our cross-sections. Yet observed $\sigma(\text{IC})$ across **21 IC series** is consistently **2.0–4.4×** this bound (median **3.4×**).

::: {.callout-important title="The floor is the ML noise excess, not pure math"}
At the pure-noise bound $\sigma = 0.047$, look-3 would be marginally powered ($n_{\min} \approx 83 < 120$ months). The floor binds because real ML-based rank-IC carries a robust noise excess of **2.0–4.4×** (median 3.4×) over the closed-form bound — reflecting model fitting noise, cross-sectional heteroskedasticity, and overlapping forward returns.
:::

### Interpretation

This refines the claim from "$\sigma \approx 0.10$ is a floor" to a mechanistic statement: **the power floor is the gap between the closed-form sampling bound and the empirically robust ML noise excess.** The excess is replicable — any researcher can compute $\sigma(\text{IC})$ on their own monthly rank-IC series and compare to $1/\sqrt{N-1}$.
:::

## 观测 $\sigma$ vs 纯噪声界 · Observed σ vs pure-noise bound

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| label: fig-sigma-excess
#| fig-cap: "观测 σ(IC) vs 纯噪声界 1/√(N−1)，所有系列均明显高于 y=x 对角线。 / Observed σ(IC) vs the pure-noise bound 1/√(N−1); every series sits well above the y=x diagonal."
df["series"] = df["source"] + " / " + df["arm"]
fig = go.Figure()
fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(
    x=df["sigma_pure_noise"], y=df["sigma_observed"], mode="markers",
    text=df["series"],
    marker={"color": df["excess_ratio"], "colorscale": "YlOrRd", "size": 11,
            "colorbar": {"title": "excess ×"}, "line": {"color": "#1e293b", "width": 0.5}},
    name="IC series",
    hovertemplate="%{text}<br>σ_null=%{x:.4f}  σ_obs=%{y:.4f}<extra></extra>",
))
lims = [0, df["sigma_observed"].max() * 1.05]
fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=lims, y=lims, mode="lines",
                         line={"color": "#dc2626", "dash": "dash"}, name="σ_obs = σ_null"))
fig.update_layout(
    template="plotly_white", height=460,
    xaxis={"title": "σ_null = 1/√(N−1) (pure-noise bound)"},
    yaxis={"title": "σ(IC) observed", "scaleanchor": "x", "scaleratio": 1},
    font={"family": "system-ui, sans-serif"},
    margin={"l": 8, "r": 8, "t": 8, "b": 8},
)
fig.show()
```
